dedupe_keys.name: global chemicals inventory gchi plant level data on 868 plants producing eight building block chemicals global energy monitor and spatial finance initiative

description: A plant-level inventory of the world's production of eight building block chemicals: ethylene, propylene and butadiene (olefins), benzene, toluene and xylene (aromatics), ammonia and methanol. The project page says it covers standalone chemical plants, oil refineries, integrated refinery and chemical complexes and ammonia and methanol plants, with location, ownership, primary and secondary products and feedstocks, each plant linked to a GEM.wiki page; it counts 868 plants in 80 countries or areas and 751 owners. The November 2025 (V1) release includes only plants operating on 1 September 2025, and each location is marked exact or approximate. The data are free to download from the project's download page, with summary tables and a tracker map; the licence is not stated on the pages read. It will become a full Global Chemicals Tracker, planned for the fourth quarter of 2026, updated annually. Coverage is global. Caveats: operating plants only, and capacities by unit are not described on the pages read. For simulation it maps chemical plants that depend on gas, power and ports and that pose accident hazards in floods and storms. Related catalogue records include the GEM Global Iron and Steel Tracker and the GEM Global Cement and Concrete Tracker.
